title: 第一卷 第17章 上了一课第一卷 第18章 仙凡有别
slug: 凡人修仙从百岁老人娶妻开始
lines: 林寻刚隐约听到了陈邪的怒啸，但那时他不可能停手。
若能从寒千山这里得到消息，也好做出判断。
“你还当我是当年么？必须先放了我，否则免谈！”
寒千山自觉抓住了软肋，脖子一梗，强硬道。
呵！
林寻嗤笑一声，从袖中抽出回春符，开口道，
“你还是对修仙者的手段了解少了，这次倒有机会体验一番。
这是仙符，对于凡人而言，可是能生白骨活死人的神药，你值得一张！”
“你，你想干什么？”寒千山顿感不妙，声音发颤道。
“我觉得你现在死，太便宜了，记得当年说过的凌迟么？
固定好你的身体，一刀刀割下血肉，你会在剧烈的疼痛中，看着自己血液流干而死。
而你的运气又比较好，有此符在，可以看着自己一边长肉，一边被割！
一个凡人最多被割三千六百刀，你来个一万刀不是难事。
你说对吧？”
林寻语气平淡，但每一个字都让寒千山汗如雨下。
“不！不不不！我什么都说！”
“现在才想说？晚了！”林寻哂笑着，一刀剐了下去，血肉横飞。
一般凌迟切下来的肉很小，害怕受刑者死亡，他有现成的回春符，倒是不用。
所以每一刀，都剐下来大片血肉！
“嘶！啊！！！妖魔！你是妖魔！”
一个时辰后，九十有余的寒千山，眼神中无助得像个孩子。
他气若游丝，言语中只有祈求。
“我...我知道的都说了，杀了我，求求你，杀了我！”
“呵！五千刀就不行了？看在当年的份上，给个痛快吧！”
一道寒光划过。
噗呲！
身上早已千疮百孔的寒千山，释然的笑了，“谢，谢谢！”
林寻长吐一口气。
当年是他救了寒千山一命，现在算还了！
寒千山不仅把关于魔修的事情交代了，还把这些年的恶行都交代了。
林寻觉得还是便宜了对方。
私设监牢，抓捕无辜女子，收集怨气喂养邪道法器。
与魔门勾结，甘为爪牙，大量劫杀凡人......
而所为的，不过是延寿。
寒家，都该死！
他拍了拍身上的灰尘，心情复杂，想到自己的所作所为，惨笑起来，

Lin Xungang vaguely heard Chen Xie's angry roar, but it was impossible for him to stop at that time.
If we can get information from Han Qianshan, we can make a judgment.
"Do you still think I'm the same person you were before? You must let me go first, otherwise there's no need to talk!"
Han Qianshan consciously grasped the weak point, strangled his neck and said forcefully.
Oh!
Lin Xun sneered, took out the rejuvenation charm from his sleeve, and said,
"You still don't know much about the methods of cultivating immortals. This time you have a chance to experience it.
This is an immortal talisman. To mortals, it is a magical elixir that can revive bones and the dead. You deserve one! "
"You, what do you want to do?" Han Qianshan suddenly felt bad and said with a trembling voice.
"I think it's too cheap for you to die now. Do you remember what Ling Chi said back then?
Fix your body, cut off the flesh and blood with a knife, and you will watch your blood drain to death in severe pain.
And your luck is relatively good. With this talisman, you can watch yourself grow and get cut at the same time!
A mortal can be cut up to 3,600 cuts at most. It's not difficult for you to get 10,000 cuts.
Are you right? "
Lin Xun's tone was calm, but every word made Han Qianshan sweat like rain.
"No! No, no, no! I'll say anything!"
"You want to say it now? It's too late!" Lin Xunxi smiled and slashed with the knife, causing blood and flesh to fly everywhere.
Usually the meat cut off by Ling Chi is very small, and he is afraid that the victim will die, so he has the rejuvenation charm ready-made, so he doesn't use it.
So every time the knife was cut, a large piece of flesh and blood was cut off!
"Hiss! Ah!!! Monster! You are a monster!"
...
An hour later, Han Qianshan, who was over ninety years old, looked as helpless as a child in his eyes.
He was as angry as a gossamer, and there was only prayer in his words.
"I...I told you everything I know, kill me, please, kill me!"
"Ha! Five thousand dollars won't suffice? For the sake of the year, let's give him a good time!"
A cold light flashed across.
Phew!
Han Qianshan, whose body was already riddled with holes, smiled in relief, "Thank you, thank you!"
Lin Xun let out a long breath.
He was the one who saved Han Qianshan's life back then, and now it's all repayment!
Han Qianshan not only confessed about the demon cultivator, but also confessed all the evil deeds he had done over the years.
Lin Xun felt that he was still getting an advantage.
Set up private prisons, arrest innocent women, and collect grievances to feed evil magic weapons.
Colluded with the Demon Sect, willingly acted as a pawn, and robbed and killed a large number of mortals...
And all it does is prolong life.
The Han family should all die!
He patted the dust on his body and felt mixed. Thinking of what he had done, he laughed miserably.
